reviews.comment: Dr. Sacchettini is knowledgeable and genuinely wants students to succeed. BICH 404 itself is not overly difficult, but I wish there were more practice problems that matched the style of exam questions. The homework prepares you fairly well though. He can be old-school with technology, but he is kind, approachable, and clearly cares about teaching.

Chill prof, he wants people to make good grades and not be stressed. Material was not hard and he was pretty straight forward on expectations. Exams aren't hard, he just doesn't have a lot of practice problems. But just do the problems in the slides and know the reasoning behind it. Don't need lab experience but if you have it this class is easy.
He provides everything you need in order to do well in his class. Exams are challenging and require you to apply what you learn but it's good for preparing students to use critical thinking.

The class material itself is not hard to understand, but the exams are not easy to prepare for. He curves exams by adding points to everyone until the highest scorer gets a 100. He cuts lectures shorter than scheduled by the university. He inputs grades at the very end. I did not like that he let students talk over him.

It was difficult to know what material would be tested, especially for the final which had very differently formatted questions in comparison to other exams. It was also hard to tell what my grade would be until the very end because he told us that he would factor attendance and test score improvement into our final grade, which ended up helping.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. S is a good and well-meaning but his lectures feel to drag on and be "unrelated" (too in-depth about things that aren't tested, tested material isn't explained well enough) to the class. His grading makes no sense and that's my biggest problem, there's really no way to calculate your grade on your own grade and there are too few assignments
